headline: Trump threatens tariffs if Mexico does not stop caravan
summary: Donald Trump threatened to impose strong tariffs on Mexico if the government of President Claudia Sheinbaum does not stop a migrant caravan heading toward the US border.
why: Tariffs on Mexico would affect the large volume of trade between the two countries, which includes autos, manufacturing and agriculture.
why_moved: The threat of strong tariffs is tied to Mexico's handling of a migrant caravan, creating trade policy uncertainty for Mexican exporters.
original_headline: Trump amenaza con aranceles si México no frena caravana
